subject: MDM / EDR / Vuln Scanner renewals - stakeholder alignment and timeline
messages:
From: Michael Grant <michael_grant@redwood.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>, procurement@vendorsecure.io
Cc: Alyssa Chen <alyssa@vulnscan.ai>
Date: Sat, 10 Apr 2027 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: MDm / EDR / Vuln scanner annual renewals - initial summary

Hi team,

We have the annual renewal window coming up for three endpoint tools: our MDM (Airlock), EDR (GuardRoot), and vulnerability scanner (VulnScan.ai). I pulled together a short Renewal_Summary_2027.xlsx (attached) with current license counts, renewal dates, and a rough cost delta if we change tiers or consolidate. High level notes: 

- Airlock (MDM): 12/31/2027 auto-renews; we have an enterprise discount option to lock pricing for 12 months.
- GuardRoot (EDR): support tier renewal 07/15/2027; recent detection regressions reported by SRE in Q1 may justify an evaluation.
- VulnScan.ai: subscription end 05/31/2027; single-source vendor for both internal and external scans.

Primary asks:
1) Confirm internal owners for negotiation and technical evaluation (I propose Tessa lead Airlock, Stephanie own GuardRoot, and Evelyn own VulnScan discussions).
2) Decide whether to run a 2-week parallel POC for VulnScan's latest engine (vendor offered extended scan pass).
3) Agree on procurement timeline so Finance can plan spend for Q2/Q3.

I've looped in Alyssa from VulnScan so she can send the updated quote and any changes to terms. Procurement (procurement@vendorsecure.io) is on copy for contract/legal lead time.

Next step: quick sync — can we meet early next week to align stakeholders and the mutual action plan? I'm proposing Mon 4/12 10am PT or Tue 4/13 2pm PT.

Thanks,

Michael
Michael Grant
Senior IT Program Manager | Redwood Inference
---
Attachment: Renewal_Summary_2027.xlsx (spreadsheet listing counts, current SKUs, renewal dates)

From: Alyssa Chen <alyssa@vulnscan.ai>
To: Michael Grant <michael_grant@redwood.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@vendorsecure.io
Date: Mon, 12 Apr 2027 08:46:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: MDm / EDR / Vuln scanner annual renewals - initial summary

Hi Michael (and team),

Thanks for the note and for including us. Attached is the updated VulnScan_Quote_Q2_2027.pdf — it reflects the volume discount at your current asset count and an optional SKU for continuous authenticated scans. Key points: 

- We can hold pricing for 60 days from the quote date.
- We’re happy to provide a complimentary 2-week engine evaluation on your staging environment; it will require an API token and a small config change for authenticated scans.
- Standard T&Cs apply; we’ve highlighted the SLAs relevant to scan turnaround and false positive triage.

If you want the POC, we can start as soon as you give the go-ahead. Proposed timeline for VulnScan:
- Week 1: token exchange and config, initial full network scan (off-hours)
- Week 2: results review, tuning, and handoff to your security team

We can also confirm a revised Statement of Work and e-sign via the VendorSecure portal (link below).

Best,

Alyssa Chen
Head of Customer Success, VulnScan.ai
alyssa@vulnscan.ai | +1 415-555-0128

From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.com>
To: Michael Grant <michael_grant@redwood.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>, Alyssa Chen <alyssa@vulnscan.ai>
Cc: procurement@vendorsecure.io
Date: Mon, 12 Apr 2027 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: MDm / EDR / Vuln scanner annual renewals - initial summary

Thanks Michael and Alyssa — good context. I agree with the proposed internal split for owners. A couple of operational items before we commit to the POC:

- Data handling: Procurement and Security require the POC scope documented (which systems, credential handling, retention). Procurement, please confirm if we can use the standard POC DPA or if vendor needs a separate agreement.
- Budget: Finance will need the final quote and any one-time fees documented (e.g., authenticated scan setup). Stephanie, can you confirm if GuardRoot requires any compensating controls before we run the VulnScan authenticated scans?
- IAM: We should use least-privileged API tokens and rotate them after the POC.

Proposed mutual action plan (short):
1) Vendor provides final quote + POC checklist (Alyssa) — due 4/13 EOD.
2) Security provides POC scope/controls (Stephanie) — due 4/13 EOD.
3) Procurement prepares draft SOW & terms (Procurement) — due 4/15.
4) Exec approval / commit (Evelyn) — target 4/20.

If that timeline works, Tessa please schedule a 30-min alignment on Tue 4/13 at 11am PT (I can do 11–12).

Evelyn
Evelyn Hart
Director, IT Operations | Redwood Inference
